reviewedFindings.reason: Installed rule explicitly concerns J2EE. This standalone storage Test requests one fixed DirectoryCalls proxy and its defining Test/Fixture loader, not a container resource or arbitrary plugin. Java25 Proxy requires interface visibility through the selected loader. Source review does not establish actual target runtime visibility; original Test stays HOLD.

reviewedFindings.reason: Fixture is configured before submit. All concurrent workers only call the same root.publishChild. Main holds stateLock over open/publish/sync and ResourceScope child cleanup, so proxy point/fault reads and live/events updates are serialized. Executor closes before Fixture teardown; configuration does not overlap workers. This is a source dependency, not runtime race-freedom proof.

finding.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation

reviewedFindings.reason: directory/file factories return a fresh map to each synchronous matrix. Explicit null values and missing/type/wrong-identity mutations are negative input. No executor/thread publication occurs in this Test; replacing with ConcurrentHashMap rejects null at fixture construction and erases the tested boundary.

finding.message: Use ReentrantLock rather than synchronization

reviewedFindings.reason: Test deliberately owns the public wrapper monitor while awaiting a separate worker operation with an explicit five/ten-second deadline. This proves production operations do not synchronize on a caller-visible object. Substituting a new ReentrantLock would no longer hold that monitor and remove the regression oracle. This does not exempt arbitrary synchronization elsewhere.

finding.message: Ensure that resources like this SeekableByteChannel object are closed after use

reviewedFindings.reason: FaultIo creates delegate and returns a SeekableByteChannel wrapper whose close closes the same delegate before injecting a close error. Main consumes returned wrapper with ResourceScope.acquire and SeekableByteChannel::close. Closing delegate in factory finally would invalidate the returned capability. Existing channels list records assertions, not a second owning capability. Unchecked allocation failure is not declared as a tested success path.

finding.message: Avoid empty catch blocks

reviewedFindings.reason: Observer counts only symlink targets equal to one directory. A descriptor removed between list and readlink is already closed, so it cannot be an open FD leak for that inode at read time. Only NoSuchFileException is ignored; other IO failures propagate and the list stream is try-with-resources. Comment explicitly records concurrent snapshot rationale. This source argument is not actual procfs or native measurement.

finding.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.

reviewedFindings.reason: Standalone original JUnit pure ownership regression, not a J2EE application/container thread. Method-specific executor TWR owns all local tasks; each actual Future get now10SECONDS, existing factory latch10SECONDS preserves interrupt and asserts its deadline. Actions use separate local Token/Harness or independent result values, not native/FD/backend. Actual whole26 termination/normal graph verified on this source; this is not a blanket Test exemption or native completion claim.
